(Currently amended) A method comprising:deriving, from radio frequency based data, pseudo sensor data representative of at least an activity of a user, the pseudo sensor data derived based on at least a machine learning model configured to transform the radio frequency based data into the pseudo sensor data; and
providing the pseudo sensor data derived based on at least the machine learning model to an application to enable the application to process the pseudo sensor data and native sensor data to enable tracking the activity of the user;
wherein the pseudo sensor data is provided during a time interval when the native sensor - data representative of the activity of the user is not provided or is unavailable;
wherein the pseudo sensor data is compatible with an application programming interface of the application, and the radio frequency based data is not compatible with the application programming interface of the application.
17. (Previously presented) The method of claim 16, wherein the radio frequency based data is generated from radio frequency signals reflected from at least the user.
